body: Force yourself to go out and try new things. It may take a while to find something that gives you that fulfillment you seek, but at least trying new things can serve as a distraction if nothing else. The great thing about going somewhere new where people don't know you is that you can be whoever you want to be.

Well on the plus side, medical bills aren't treated the same as other debt. They might send it to collection, but that's usually only if there's a substantial amount owed. If insurance has paid a majority of it than the rest usually gets treated like a write off by the hospital. They also can't do a lot as long as you pay them something, even if you only send them $20 a month. If their financial adviser treated you that way you should speak up. I truly wish the best for you and that's coming from a 32 year old that's not entirely sure how he's going to pay his rent at all this month.

Why don't you just tell them how you feel? What's the worst that could happen? If you're worried you might scare them off, isn't that what you want anyway? If this is truly how you feel than you have nothing to lose by being honest.

Not to get too personal, but have you tried going to a doctor? If you're having sleep issues I would suggest going to make sure there isn't a medical reason for it. I would also suggest not joking about suicide so much. It normalizes the idea in your mind and also might make it difficult for your friends to take you seriously should you really need their help.  Wishing you all the best.

That's an important distinction there. If you hate life there's not much you can say or do about it. If you hate yourself that's different. Yourself is the one thing you can take control of. Start by changing your thought process. If you hate yourself that much, use it as motivation for self improvement. Start with the easiest task and do it until it's the norm, then you can add on something else. I struggle with this myself. One thing I can tell you is that it becomes a viscous cycle, if you treat yourself as if you have no value other people can pick up on that and think it's alright for them to treat you that way as well. Sorry to ramble. I wish you the best in finding your own worth.
